description.value: Amir Bakery is a North Vancouver institution on Lonsdale Avenue specializing in freshly baked Iranian flatbreads including Barbari, Taftoon, and Lavash, along with a selection of Iranian food products. The bakery opens very early and is known for its fragrant, high-quality breads made using traditional techniques. It's a distinctive stop for cyclists looking for fresh bread and Middle Eastern provisions on the North Shore.
